overview.description: The Tema International Defense ETF (ARMY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in industrials equity. The fund seeks long-term growth by actively managing a narrow portfolio of companies capitalizing on structural, technological, and geopolitical shifts driving defense spending worldwide. The funds investments target those within the aerospace and defense sector while excluding stocks listed in North America. ARMY was launched on Sep 25, 2025 and is issued by Tema.
